generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; never NULL; unique per table.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy from parent key pool; 10% NULL when nullable; ensure at least one NULL and at least one parent row without children.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_quantity: Positive integers sampled uniformly from [1, 1000]; never NULL unless column nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_area_population: Positive integers sampled from [1000, 100000000]; never NULL unless nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_measure: Positive reals sampled from [10.0, 10000.0] with one decimal; never NULL unless nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Random short alphabetic strings 3-20 chars; 5% near-duplicate variants (case/whitespace) when column is DISTINCT target.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Uniform choice from the column's enum list; never NULL unless nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Dates formatted 'Month D, YYYY' or 'YYYY'; sampled from 1990-01-01 to 2020-12-31.
generic_sampling_rules.text_numeric_string: Numeric strings sampled from [10.0, 200.0] with one decimal, stored as text.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L, include L, L-step, L+step where step is 1 for ints and 0.1 for reals.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: For each ORDER column, plant at least two rows sharing the top value and at least two sharing the second value.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, 10% NULL rows per instance, at least one NULL row.

Ensure Country_ID groups of size 0, 1, and 2.
Plant 20-50% duplicate Country_ID values.
Ensure Country_ID groups of size 1, 2, and >=3.
Plant two rows sharing the maximum Country_ID.

Ensure at least two distinct Length values per Country_ID group.

Ensure Name groups of size 0, 1, and 2.
